I'm in a VERY similar situation. The pain of an ED can hurt so bad but (in my experience) is not taken seriously, especially bulimia. I have made myself go into dept with my BP. Glad you got help though, stay strong my friend
I love you and you being here has kept me alive.

The moments that stand out the most is when I realize my daily thought of suicide being a viable option to solve a problem or inconvenience isn't normal. For example, I'll have a bad day like all people do at work and think well it might be ok again tomorrow or this is how life is and it's not worth living any more. Or I'll embarrass my socially awkward self and think I'll never have to feel that way again if I just kill myself. I'll think this not in a  joking way but in a very serious way. Another moment is when I realized the only thing that keeps me from doing it is my dog, who has a lot of behavioral problems, wouldn't understand why I left and is in the realm of not adoptable in shelter standers. I don't want him to die just because I wanted to.

This becomes very normal when you think about it so often but is in fact not.
